title: Aive App Integration Corpus
subtitle: Chat-format training and gating data that teaches Qwen2.5-0.5B to work inside The Aive
description: Optional copy of the corpus the notebook builds itself. Generated from the contracts in HereLiesAz/aive. train/validation/test/adversarial .jsonl rows carry id, family (F1..F7), system, user, expected, split and checks. manifest.json records the source commit and the SHA-256 of every file; score.py scores the declarative checks per family and applies the release gates.
